Everyday dentistry

Dental hygiene

Support for healthier teeth and gums, every day.

Ask about this treatment

Understanding your options

Hygiene appointments focus on gum health, professional cleaning and practical advice for caring for your mouth at home. The team can recommend an appointment interval based on your needs, rather than a fixed schedule for everyone.

What to expect

  1. Discuss your home routine and assess gum health.
  2. Remove deposits where clinically appropriate.
  3. Agree on home care and a suitable review interval.

A common question

How often should I book?

Your dentist or dental therapist can recommend how frequently to attend after assessing your oral health and risk factors.

Your consultation is the place to discuss suitability, benefits, risks, alternatives and costs for your individual care.
